spec.description:
Permastop Building Blanket is a reflective glasswool insulation
blanket factory-laminated with Sisalation reflective foil facing, designed for
thermal performance, condensation control, and acoustic absorption under
residential and commercial metal roofs and in external walls. Composed of
bio-soluble glasswool bonded to light, medium, or heavy-duty aluminium foil with
an anti-glare finish, it reflects radiant heat while dramatically reducing rain
impact drumming noise. Available in R-values from R1.3 to R3.6 (including an
industry-leading R3.6 in 130mm), it satisfies NCC requirements and bushfire
ratings up to BAL-40.
features:
Factory-laminated with Sisalation
reflective foil facing with 150mm overlap flap

High thermal performance with
R-values from R1.3 up to R3.6 (130mm)

Outstanding acoustic absorption
significantly reducing rain noise drumming on metal roofs

Controls
condensation formation on the underside of metal roof sheeting
Non-combustible glasswool core complying with AS 1530.1

Suitable for
bushfire-prone areas with BAL Low-40 ratings in roof systems per AS 3959
Manufactured in Australia from up to 80% recycled glass

Features an
anti-glare coating on one side for installer safety

Bio-soluble safe-to-use
FBS-1 formulation with low VOC emissions

Compatible with Fletcher Roof Razor
system to minimize thermal bridging

install:
Roll out Permastop over roof
framing purlins or safety wire mesh with reflective foil facing downward towards
building interior

Ensure 150mm factory overlap flap extends over the adjacent
roll

Tape all foil lap joints securely with 72mm reinforced aluminium foil
tape to form a continuous vapour barrier

Allow a nominal 40mm sag between
purlins to promote condensation drainage towards the eaves if unmeshed

Fasten
metal roof sheeting directly over the glasswool blanket through to purlins

Ensure blanket terminates neatly at the gutter line without obstructing
stormwater flow

Use Roof Razor spacers in commercial roofs to avoid blanket
compression over purlins
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof type
(pitched or curved metal deck roof, shed, or commercial warehouse)

Select
required R-value (R1.3 to R3.6) to meet NCC roof energy compliance

Choose
foil duty rating (Light, Medium, or Heavy Duty) based on span and traffic
Calculate total roof area including 150mm overlap allowance

Order
matching 72mm reinforced foil tape and safety wire mesh
limitations:
Must not be left exposed to
rain or weather prior to roof sheet installation

Foil lap joints must be
taped continuously to maintain vapour barrier performance

For tropical
high-humidity climates, specify Permastop Tropic with outward-facing foil

retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher Permastop Building Blanket is a reflective glasswool insulation
blanket factory-bonded to a Sisalation foil facing with a 150mm overlap flap.
Available in ratings from R1.3 to R3.6 (55mm to 130mm thick) in 1200mm wide
rolls, it is installed under residential and commercial metal roofs to prevent
condensation dripping, reflect radiant heat, and dampen rain drumming noise.
Built with non-combustible glasswool (AS 1530.1) and low-flammability foil
(Index ≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant), it provides a complete thermal, acoustic, and
vapour barrier for metal-clad structures.
